annotations.title: Post to a staff chat group

description: Posts one message to a staff chat group: subject opens the post, each point is a bullet in its thread. A link is written [words](https://address) and shows as the words. First call without confirm: a preview of the exact text and the group, nothing is sent. Show the preview to the owner word for word; only on the owner's yes to that text call again with the same values, confirm true and preview_id. Owner only. Needs the owner's sign-in.

confirm.description: true to send the post shown in the preview

group.description: The group's name exactly as chat_groups lists it, e.g. Remote - HQ

mention_all.description: true tags everyone in the group (@all) on the post; only when the owner asked for it

points.description: The bullets, one point each, up to 300 characters each, posted as one reply in the post's thread; links as [words](https://address)

subject.description: The post's one line: what it is about, up to 200 characters; may carry one [words](https://address) link

name: post_to_chat_group
